what: every level of the frame this batch was drawn from, with the stratum it was cut into. The draw record freezes each stratum's N and inclusion probability; this says WHICH level is in which stratum, so more panels can be added to the same strata without recutting deciles from a score file.
written_by: pipeline/draw_batch.py frame_strata is what reads it; written once, by hand, against the frozen record (docs/DECISIONS.md)
key: (WMO, CYCLE_NUMBER, PRES) with PRES = round(PRES_ADJUSTED); sorted by that key
decile_rule: eddy_pump.batches.score_deciles: rank of `score` over the WHOLE pool, ties broken by (WMO, CYCLE_NUMBER, PRES_ADJUSTED), rank * 10 // len(pool)
score_bounds_check: the 20 per-decile score_min/score_max the draw record froze, compared with the same bounds recut here: every one equal to the last bit (largest relative difference 0.0). The score VALUES are the August ones; only the parquet bytes moved.
how_it_was_made: the 2026-08-27 upward score file no longer existed (the upward classifier was retrained on 2026-09-03). It was regenerated on 2026-09-07 from the archive recipe at mkeutgen/eddy-pump-archive commit e7a625c: production/score_study_pools.py, upward half only, sklearn HistGradientBoostingClassifier(max_iter=300, lr=0.05, leaves=31, l2=1.0), seed 0, 168 feature columns, 4,824 old labels (2,437 training walk + 2,387 uniform b6) read from that commit's data/labels/reviews.parquet, StratifiedGroupKFold(5) grouped by float for the out-of-fold scores. The bytes of the parquet differ from the August one because the feature table was rebuilt on 2026-09-02, but the fit is the same to every digit printed: out-of-fold AUC 0.8839291198329342 and rho 0.5765719339092102 on the uniform reviews, both equal to the August record. The deciles were then recut with eddy_pump.batches.score_deciles over the whole 186,275-level pool and crossed with the held region, exactly as production/build_batches.py did at archive commit cc5709f, and all ten open counts equal the frozen record.
score_file: regenerated from archive commit e7a625c; kept in the scratchpad only, never in results/
held_region_rule: a level is HELD (outside this pin) when its entry in that file scores 1.96 sigma or more on both AOU and absolute salinity at the detection point; 14,697 levels, the region rate_obduction_02 sampled
